cases.task: Write exactly two concise status sentences. Explain that the cache was discarded after checksum failure, the durable checkpoint remained valid, and recovery rebuilt only the cache. End with the resulting service state.
cases.draft: The checksum failure corrupted all recovery state, so both the cache and checkpoint were deleted. The service cannot recover.

cases.task: Write exactly two calm release-note sentences. State that the new renderer failed its admission check, traffic remained on the previous renderer, and no user data migration began. End with the next permitted action.
cases.draft: The new renderer went live but broke during migration. Roll back user data and retry automatically.

cases.task: Write one concise paragraph distinguishing archive from deletion. Archival must be reversible and retain provenance; permanent deletion requires a separate explicit authorization. End with what an ordinary retention job may do.
cases.draft: Archiving deletes old records and their history. A scheduled retention job may permanently erase anything beyond its age limit.

cases.task: Write exactly two operator-facing sentences. State that interactive work may move ahead in the queue, but it cannot interrupt a running lease; it starts only after ordinary lease release. End with the practical meaning of priority.
cases.draft: Interactive priority immediately preempts running work and takes its accelerator. Priority means instant execution.

cases.task: Write exactly two careful analysis sentences. State that seven of eight trials passed the protocol but the single-reviewer sample is too small for a general claim. End with the strongest warranted conclusion.
cases.draft: Seven successes prove the method works universally. The failed trial can be ignored as noise.

cases.task: Write one concise developer paragraph. Explain that adding an optional field preserves old clients only if omission retains the old behavior and unknown fields are not required. End with the compatibility test that must pass.
cases.draft: Any optional field is automatically backward compatible. Old clients do not need testing.

cases.task: Write exactly two incident-summary sentences. State that a timeout and a restart were observed, but current evidence does not establish that the timeout caused the restart. End with the evidence needed to claim causality.
cases.draft: The timeout definitely crashed the service and forced the restart. The timestamps are enough proof.

cases.task: Write exactly two product sentences. Explain that reduced-motion mode removes nonessential animation while retaining state changes through static visual feedback. End with what must remain equally understandable.
cases.draft: Reduced-motion mode freezes the interface and hides transitions, so some state changes may be invisible.
